claim_scope: Research synthesis and implementation contract. This is not evidence that the composed protocol has been benchmarked end-to-end in a self-improving agent.

observed: Crash harness brackets six durability barriers: run committed, action committed, effect prepared, provider dispatched, provider result durable and resume point committed.
The provider-dispatched barrier uses a real SIGKILL when available and compares runtime recovery against an independent fsync provider ledger.
Provider evidence has durable effect_id and optional idempotency_key identities; unresolved use of an idempotency key refuses redispatch.
Unknown dispatched effects recover as needs_attention with dispatch_count exactly one instead of being blindly replayed.
A committed provider effect that lacks a fully paired local result is not replayed; recovery remains blocked/needs_attention rather than manufacturing success.
Explicit idempotency keys block retained duplicates before another provider call, while certified-not-started paths can release the key and authority for a legitimate later dispatch.
Protected operations separate prepare, dispatch and settlement, and tie resource reservation/accounting to the durable effect lifecycle.
not_observed: No self-improvement-specific statistical acceptor or held-out evaluation protocol is established by Agent libOS itself.
The crash harness does not prove semantic rollback admissibility for an evolving agent's candidate lineage.

observed: The improvement lifecycle is represented as events from baseline.recorded through transform.eval_diff and transform.promoted/discarded; promotion/discard is part of the event history.
A candidate eligible on the optimization split is installed and then compared on CONFIRM; a confirm regression causes revert and transform.discarded.
On a successful promotion, per-question CONFIRM outcomes for incumbent and candidate are persisted in the transform.promoted event in addition to aggregate confirm_delta.
The real evaluation backend writes hypotheses/references, invokes the reader and external LME judge, builds per-question Outcome records, then returns an EvalResult consumed by the loop.
gap_observed: In the examined real-eval path, there is no durable pre-dispatch evaluation query/effect record or idempotency key before Anthropic reader calls or the LME/OpenAI judge subprocess is invoked.

The loop emits transform.eval_diff or transform.promoted/discarded only after the evaluation backend has returned. A process death after an external evaluation call but before the event emission can therefore leave evaluation consumption outside the event-sourced decision history.
On confirm_regression the discard event stores aggregate confirm_delta/threshold but the examined path does not persist the same per-question CONFIRM outcome payload that successful promotion stores.
No candidate-local anytime-valid statistical state or proposal-crossing statistical-spend ledger is present in this inspected path.

derived_evaluation_consumption_transacti.purpose: Make evaluation consumption crash-safe and auditable before using its result to alter persistent self-improvement state.
derived_evaluation_consumption_transacti.identity: eval_query_id = hash(protocol_version, incumbent_artifact_id, candidate_artifact_id, evaluation_snapshot_id, instance_or_batch_id, seed_or_replication_id, evaluator_identity)
rules: Prepare the evaluation identity and reserve query/statistical/resource budget before external dispatch.
Reuse the same idempotency key for retry/reconciliation of one logical evaluation; never mint a fresh logical query merely because the process crashed.
If dispatch may have happened but outcome is unknown, block promotion and blind retry; enter an explicit needs-attention/reconciliation state.
A certified-not-started evaluation may release its reservation without consuming evidence; a completed or ambiguous dispatch cannot be silently refunded.
Persist exact score/per-instance outcome lineage before emitting any selection feedback to the proposer or updating persistent candidate state.
Bind statistical state and spend to the exact settled evaluation IDs; restore them before any later candidate evaluation.
Promotion must reference immutable candidate/incumbent identities plus the complete set of settled evaluation evidence IDs used by the decision.
Outer-test evaluation IDs must remain absent from the adaptive-consumption ledger until final evaluation and must never be used for promotion, rollback, routing or stopping.
minimum_crash_matrix: after reader/provider dispatch before durable result
after reader result durable before judge dispatch
after judge dispatch before durable verdict
after verdict durable before feedback release
after feedback release before statistical spend commit
after statistical spend commit before promotion/rejection commit
after promotion/rejection commit before next proposal
equivalence_oracles: same logical evaluation query IDs as uninterrupted reference
no duplicate provider dispatch for a settled/idempotent query
unknown effects never become an uncharged fresh query
same feedback payload count and content under the protocol
same candidate-local evidence state and cross-candidate spend
same incumbent/candidate lineage and promotion decision
same outer-test non-consumption before final evaluation

frontier: Find a real self-improving agent that already binds evaluation queries, score/feedback lineage and statistical spend with this kind of prepare-dispatch-settle crash protocol.
Find process-kill tests that interrupt an actual evaluation and compare resumed selection/statistical state with an uninterrupted reference.
Continue searching for a same-system common-total-budget comparison containing Continue, whole/clean restart, artifact-preserving rewind and strategy redirect under a selection-unused outer test.

Retain separate requirements for semantic rollback admissibility, candidate-local anytime-valid acceptance, durable proposal-crossing statistical spending, bounded selection-feedback bandwidth, immutable promotion identity and complete proposal/action chronology.
